newsitem.title: USA: National Re sets shr exchange in merger.
newsitem.headline: National Re sets shr exchange in merger.

text.p: National Re Corp said Tuesday holders of less than 50 percent of the company's outstanding shares elected to receive cash in connection with the merger with General Re Corp.

As a result, all National Re shares covered by stock elections will be exchanged for General Re common stock, and all shares covered by cash elections will be exchanged for $53 in cash, without any proration.

Holders of National Re shares who failed to properly vote by the September 30 deadline, or who voted but fail to properly deliver their shares, will receive shares of General Re common stock, the company said.
The merger is expected to become effective October 3.
